ios.desc:
MediFamily is a private family health organizer and smart reminder utility designed to help households manage daily wellness routines, pill reminders, doctor appointments, and personal health documents in one secure place.

100% PRIVATE & OFFLINE-FIRST VAULT
- Zero Cloud Exposure: Your family's confidential records never touch external servers.
- Local AES-256 Encryption: Schedules, appointments, vaccine records, documents, and measurements are encrypted locally on your device.
- Zero Account Required: Start immediately without registering an account or creating passwords.

SMART MEDICATION REMINDERS & INVENTORY
- Flexible Schedules: Daily, weekly, cyclic, interval, and as-needed (PRN) alarms.
- Exact Alarms: High-priority notifications that keep you on schedule throughout the day.
- FEFO Stock Tracking: Household medicine cabinet tracking with low-stock and expiration warnings.
- 1-Tap Logging: Mark doses as taken, snoozed, or skipped directly from notifications.
- Dose History: Fractional dosing support and full chronological intake audit logs.

MULTI-PROFILE FAMILY HUB
- Unified Household View: Organize children, parents, spouses, and elderly relatives from one dashboard.
- Quick-Switch Profiles: Color badges, customizable avatars, and age indicators.
- Emergency Health ID: Quick access to blood type, critical allergies, and physician contacts.

WELLNESS VITALS & WHO GROWTH CHARTS (MANUAL LOGGING)
- Vitals Journal: Log Blood Pressure, Blood Glucose, Heart Rate, Temperature, SpO2, and Weight.
- Manual Entry Only: All vital readings are manually entered by the user from their own certified home measurement devices; the app does not measure vitals directly or connect to external medical hardware.
- WHO Growth Percentiles: Standard WHO Height-for-age, Weight-for-age, and BMI-for-age reference percentiles.
- Visual Trend Graphs: Clean interactive graphs with standard reference ranges.

HEALTH DOCUMENTS VAULT
- Digitize Paper Records: Securely store lab test photos, prescription labels, and doctor summaries.
- Document Photography Only: Camera access is used solely for photographing printed paper documents, medication packaging, and doctor notes for on-device encrypted storage; it is NOT used as an optical physiological sensor.
- Fast Viewer: Multi-page document viewer with PDF preview and instant search.

DOCTOR VISITS & CARE NOTES
- Appointment Calendar: Track upcoming visits, physician names, clinic locations, and specialties.
- Consultation Notes: Record
